Bid Summary.value: The Dallas Independent School District has issued Request for Proposal JA-207652 seeking student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, display monitors, and deployment services. Vendors may submit proposals for one, several, or all categories for an initial contract term of three years with two one-year renewal options. Specified requirements include an Intel i5 14th Generation processor or equivalent, 16GB DDR5 RAM, 256GB NVMe storage, and Windows 11 Pro operating system. Bidders are required to submit Form 1295 Certificate of Interested Parties and a certificate of insurance. Sealed manual submissions must be delivered to the Procurement Services Department by July 9, 2024, at 2:00 PM CST, following a pre-bid meeting scheduled for June 10, 2024, at 3:00 PM EDT.
